articles.headline: Downtown security officers begin strike
articles.summary: Security guards began striking at Salesforce Tower, the Transbay transit center and other downtown properties on September 18. The Chronicle reported an impasse in contract negotiations.

articles.headline: Front Street hosts Oktoberfest
articles.summary: A free downtown Oktoberfest celebration ran September 18 with music, food and games.

articles.headline: Mountain lion captured in Outer Sunset
articles.summary: City officials captured a mountain lion on September 18 after sightings near 44th Avenue and Ulloa Street, according to The San Francisco Standard.

articles.headline: California gasoline reaches $6 a gallon
articles.summary: The Chronicle reported a statewide average of $6 per gallon on September 14 and a San Francisco average of $6.16, citing AAA. Statewide prices had risen 42 cents over the preceding month.

articles.headline: Raising Cane’s announces first San Francisco opening
articles.summary: Raising Cane’s announced plans to open at 211 Jefferson Street at Fisherman’s Wharf on September 21. The September 14 report describes a planned opening, not an already operating restaurant.

articles.headline: Dreamforce brings conference activity to downtown
articles.summary: A September 14 Chronicle report previewed Dreamforce at Moscone Center for September 15–17 and described a 50,000-person conference. That figure is the reported conference size, not verified foot traffic or restaurant demand.
